title: A new batch run's runner timeout is at most 90 minutes
description: Runs the real loop gate step over hours of recorded run history beside busy trial slots, launching its check through the detached trial runner: the run's spec and outer deadline are at most 90 minutes, never a multiple of the gate's bound, every check is kept, and the run settles on its verdict (GY-3509).

steps.name: a new batch run's spec and outer deadline stay within 90 minutes with every check kept
